title: Round 130 (F436): WIL frame loader 0x466130 - mode byte [ecx+4]: 0 -> 0x466640 (.wil file mode), 1/2 -> 0x466720 (mmap mode); 17-byte (0x11) frame header read, words*2 payload ReadFile; LRU cache evict 0x3A98ms (0x466770) + 0x493E0ms timeout; IAT SetFilePointer 0x4761EC/GetTickCount 0x47611C/UnmapViewOfFile 0x4760F8
objective: Decode the shared WIL frame loader 0x466130 used by both HUD (F29) and monster draw (F435).
question: How does the client load a single WIL frame (header + payload) and cache it?
method: Disasm 0x466130 (dispatch), 0x466640 (file mode), 0x466720 (mmap mode), 0x466770 (LRU evict); IAT resolve.

lru_evict_0x466770.scan: frame entries [0x10] x stride 0x20; evict if tick - entry[0] > 0x493E0 (300000ms)

contrast.file_vs_mmap: .wil file mode reads header+payload per frame; mmap mode = WIX offsets into mapped file (no per-frame IO)
contrast.sprite_vs_hud: same loader, different mode byte = two WIL storage schemes

verdict: WIL frame loader 0x466130 PRIMARY-verified: mode dispatch (file/mmap), 17-byte header + words*2 payload, 3 IAT (SetFilePointer/GetTickCount/UnmapViewOfFile), LRU eviction at 0x3A98/0x493E0ms. Shared by HUD (F29) and monster draw (F435).
notes: mmap mode = WIX offset table in [0x30], base in [0x34]
